name: Llama 3.3

weak.d: Reasoning at very long contexts degrades.

res.d: Strong instruction-following on complex tasks; competitive with closed models.

lims: Context ceiling — reasoning degrades in very long contexts.
blurb: Final Llama 3 model. At 86% MMLU, competitive with GPT-4o. The open-weights ecosystem reached a point where the gap to frontier closed in was largely closed for most tasks.

val.b: Internal Meta evaluation + Purple Llama, Nov 2024

ability.name: Parity
ability.text: 86.0 on MMLU, matching GPT-4o, at the point the open-weights gap effectively closed for most tasks.
